source: tolong buatkan map gunung yang bagus cakpe pemandangan bagus

image_prompt.text: A dominant summit visible from everywhere on the map, telling the player where they are
Walking routes threading up and around the slopes so movement has a grain
Composed overlooks placed for the best views of the scenery
A mountain landform - ridges, slopes and a peak - as the map itself

notes: Prompt is Indonesian, read as 'please make a good mountain map with nice scenery'.
No game type is named, so this is a place build rather than a genre build.
Verticality set to tiered because a mountain carries real elevation; nothing implied overhangs.

open_questions.ask: Should the mountain look photoreal and rugged, or bright and stylised?
Is there anything to do on the mountain, or is it a place to look at and walk around?
A single peak you can cross in a minute, or a whole range to roam?

coverage_missing.ask: Should the mountain look photoreal and rugged, or bright and stylised?

answers.ask: Should the mountain look photoreal and rugged, or bright and stylised?
answers.answer: Buat tampilannya bright dan stylised, dengan pemandangan gunung yang indah dan enak dilihat.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do on the mountain, or is it a place to look at and walk around?
answers.answer: Ini tempat untuk jalan-jalan dan menikmati pemandangan saja; tidak perlu mekanik atau aktivitas khusus.

answers.ask: A single peak you can cross in a minute, or a whole range to roam?
answers.answer: Buat satu puncak gunung kecil yang bisa diseberangi sekitar satu menit agar map tetap fokus dan rapi.
